interpretation: A change in a selected modeled continuation does not by itself change the actual commitment. All same-action pairs here have the same stored actual context and next-state inputs. Do not add forced plan persistence merely to remove that variability.
limits: All registered known-loss roots retained; not representative of ordinary states.
Different banks of the same sample count are disjoint. Three- and eight-sample banks overlap and are not independent.
Cross-bank gaps measure model-estimate selection sensitivity, not actual regret or causal long-play loss.
Unrestricted gaps include proposals excluded by personality. They are accounting only, never an available improvement or intelligence error.
A fixed plan is the same controller with different imagined observations, not an identical future trajectory.
Same factual commit inputs compares the stored action/context/next-state packet; it is not a new feedback replay.
Persona purpose sacrifice is recorded separately; no personality or selection rule is changed.
No statistical confidence, better action claim, new scientific trial, or adoption follows.
